questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A- Gathering her courage, she approached him, nervously clutching her autograph book.B- Just as she was about to leave, Sonu gave her a few words of encouragement, telling her to always follow her dreams. C- Sonu greeted her with a warm smile, instantly putting her at ease as they chatted about her favourite songs. D- He graciously signed her book and even agreed to take a selfie, making Priya's day unforgettable. E- Priya's heart raced with excitement as she spotted Sonu Nigam at the airport lounge, her favourite singer casually sipping coffee.  F- As she walked away, she felt an overwhelming sense of joy and inspiration from the brief but memorable encounter. 799

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A - As quickly as the encounter began, the lion sauntered off into the wilderness, leaving Sarah with a newfound reverence for the untamed beauty of nature.B- Deep in the heart of the African savannah, Sarah, a wildlife photographer on assignment, had a heart-stopping encounter with a majestic lion. C- The lion regarded her with a curious, almost indifferent gaze, its golden mane catching the light in a mesmerising display. D- Venturing cautiously through the tall grass, camera in hand, she stumbled upon a clearing where the lion lounged lazily under the afternoon sun. E- Time seemed to stand still as their eyes locked, Sarah froze in awe and trepidation at the proximity of such raw power. F- Sensing no immediate threat, Sarah slowly raised her camera, capturing the essence of wild grace in every frame.  796
Which of the following sentences has an ANTONYM of the word 'anathema'?
options: It is hard to find unconditional love these days when even parents have toxic relationships with their children.
The long-standing antipathy between the two villages was discussed in the Panchayat.
Her haemoglobin levels are healthy now, and she does not need a blood transfusion.
My mother has been indifferent to my needs ever since my sibling was born.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (It is hard to find unconditional love these days when even parents have toxic relationships with their children.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following idioms mean 'to have a medical operation or surgery'?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Go under the knife) है।
